mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN progress = 100 THEN 1 END) AS expandFinishCount, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(recovery_rate),1), 0) AS recoveryRate FROM debt_expand WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS date, IFNULL(AVG(progress), 0) AS progress FROM debt_expand WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT s.name AS name, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(d.recovery_rate),1), 0) AS value FROM debt_expand d LEFT JOIN station_info s ON d.station_id = s.id WHERE d.deleted = 0 GROUP BY d.station_id, s.name
